header: UNVERIFIED — definitions of the time windows used by festival observance rules. Must be reviewed by a priest.

provenance.notes: Entered by the autonomous build from general knowledge of common definitions. Traditions differ (e.g. some define Pradosh as 2 ghatis either side of sunset).

description: Each observance rule names a window on a panchang day. A festival is observed on the day whose window overlaps the festival's tithi the most (see src/core/festivals.ts). 'instant' windows are a single moment; 'dayParts' splits sunrise→sunset into equal parts; 'nightMuhurtas' splits sunset→next sunrise into 15 equal muhurtas (1-based, inclusive).
